title: dotsteward platforms/<platform>.toml
description: What differs on one platform, schema version 1. The file name is the platform: a release (ubuntu-22.04, macos-15), an operating system (ubuntu, macos) or a Nix platform (linux, darwin); the most specific file of a machine wins key by key. Unknown keys are errors.
$comment: Readers interpret the keyword subset of workstation.schema.json. The CLI reads the components, the stage-0 mirror the fast path; nothing else of the file reaches Nix.

fast_path.description: A Linux release that takes the fast route of the bootstrap like [platform.linux.fast_path] of workstation.toml, whose desktop rule still applies. It names the release of the file.

components.description: What this platform says about a component, by its name.

unavailable.description: The component does not exist on this platform, and why: every command and Nix leave it out on a machine of the platform.

version.description: The version constraint of the component on this platform, in place of the one of workstation.toml: a series as in workstation.toml (16, 16.*, 5:27). It binds apt on a machine of the platform and the shared pins as soon as one machine runs it.

reason.description: Why the version is constrained on this platform.
